definition.zh: 身高、体重、头围、BMI 测量
definition.en: Height, weight, head circumference and BMI measurements

definition.zh: 左右眼视力、眼轴、眼压等眼部检查
definition.en: Left and right visual acuity, axial length, eye pressure and other eye exams

definition.zh: 体能测试成绩和运动记录
definition.en: Fitness test results and sport activity records

definition.zh: 每晚睡眠时长、入睡和起床时间、午睡
definition.en: Nightly sleep duration, bedtime and wake time, naps

definition.zh: 户外活动时长和家长设定的每周户外目标
definition.en: Outdoor activity minutes and the parent's weekly outdoor goal

definition.zh: 出牙、换牙、龋齿、洗牙、牙科就诊和矫正记录
definition.en: Tooth eruption and loss, cavities, cleanings, dental visits and orthodontic records

definition.zh: 就诊、急诊、住院、体检、用药等医疗事件
definition.en: Doctor visits, emergencies, hospital stays, checkups, medication and other medical events

definition.zh: 发育里程碑、青春期发育自评、骨龄、体脂率
definition.en: Developmental milestones, puberty self-assessments, bone age and body fat

definition.zh: 体态自查（肩、背、骨盆、腿、足跟等）
definition.en: Posture self-checks (shoulders, back, pelvis, legs, heels and similar)

definition.zh: 家长写的成长随记和观察
definition.en: Growth journal entries and observations written by the parent
